cd /work && python3 -c "
def collapse_ints(nums):
    uniq = sorted(set(nums))
    parts = []
    i = 0
    while i < len(uniq):
        j = i
        while j + 1 < len(uniq) and uniq[j+1] == uniq[j] + 1:
            j += 1
        if j - i + 1 >= 4:
            a, b = uniq[i], uniq[j]
            sa = f'({a})' if a < 0 else str(a)
            sb = f'({b})' if b < 0 else str(b)
            parts.append(f'{sa}-{sb}')
        else:
            parts.extend(str(x) for x in uniq[i:j+1])
        i = j + 1
    return ','.join(parts)

print(repr(collapse_ints([1,2,3,4])))
